relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: In a mouse model for LDD, persistent NLRP3 activation in microglia significantly increased the severity of LDD and LDD-associated neuropathic pain

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3-depleted microglia decreased both their phagocytosis potential and production of proinflammatory cytokines

key_findings: NLRP3 is exclusively expressed in disc microglia and its levels correlate with patient pain score.
Microglia-specific NLRP3 depletion attenuated LDD and pain in mice while persistent activation worsened them.
